name: Ripples of Undeath
clause: At the beginning of your first main phase, mill three cards. Then you may pay {1} and 3 life. If you do, put a card from among those cards into your hand.

needs.semantics: 'Put a card from among those cards into your hand' — act on a CHOSEN SUBSET of the objects the binding frame holds. Today `move` with what:'those' moves every bound object; the wording is common after mill / dig / look-top / impulse.
needs.clause: put a card from among those cards into your hand

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'optional-cost'; cost: AbilityCost; then: Effect[] } — `optional-pay` generalised from ManaCost to AbilityCost
needs.semantics: 'Then you may pay {1} and 3 life. If you do, ...'. `optional-pay` takes a bare ManaCost, so any optional cost mixing mana with life, a sacrifice, a discard or an exile has no form. Reuses the payment planner and nonManaCostPayable that `unless-pays` already calls.
needs.clause: Then you may pay {1} and 3 life. If you do, put a card from among those cards into your hand.

needs.semantics: 'At the beginning of your first main phase' / 'your precombat main phase' / 'each player's postcombat main phase'. TRIGGER_VOCAB has upkeep, draw-step, combat-begin, end-step and end-of-turn but no main phase at all.
needs.clause: At the beginning of your first main phase, mill three cards.
